Whisper always processes thirty seconds, with or without speech inside — so in a normal meeting this cuts the time in half or better. Cuts happen only in silences of at least 0.4 s, with slack around the words, and the timestamps go back to the right minute of the meeting. If any stretch lands in the wrong place, untick it and run again: the minutes come out the same, it just takes longer.
